8.3.4 LdCom_Transmit
[SWS_LDCOM_00026] Definition of API function LdCom_Transmit
Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02110
⌈
Service Name
LdCom_Transmit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LdCom_Transmit (
PduIdType Id,
const PduInfoType* InfoPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x49
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different Ids. Non reentrant for the same Id.
Id
Identifier of the signal to be transmitted.
Parameters (in)
InfoPtr
Length of and pointer to the signal data and pointer to MetaData.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted.
Description
Requests transmission of a signal.
Available via
LdCom.h
⌋
